binding_requirements: Freeze captured source bytes, version limits, extraction text, capture/request hashes, source order and reversible excerpt maps before annotation.
Keep availability cutoff separate from event time; current correction quotations do not establish earlier captured prefixes.
Resolved reading maps exactly to one TemporalClaim with matching source, normalized entity/relation/scope and exact value.
Whole replacement binds exact resolved endpoint IDs, equal factual keys/scopes, same declared asserting authority and exact correcting-source reference offsets.
Authority attribution is one record per source; mixed speakers require explicitly mapped attribution units.
Dependency binds exact dependent/prerequisite claim IDs, exact evidence in dependent source, earlier-or-same-day prerequisite availability and an acyclic graph.
Every dependency is an essential AND prerequisite; record and adjudicate independent alternative support before adding an edge.
Keep original source modality, numerical units, meaningful atomic scope, reporting date and unknown bounds; add no observation or interval to enable QA.
Reader and decoder receive identical frozen eligible source content; source projection claims must be explicit.
Pinned reader needs prompt/schema, model/runtime revisions, request/source hashes, context/truncation policy, generation settings, raw response and exact evidence spans.
Reference adjudication is separate from reader, candidate, scorer and decoder outputs.
Scored decoder comparison requires actual raw candidate/scoring receipts, immutable shared base cache, policy hashes, aliases, objective, limits and seeds.

explicit_selection_policy_illustration.roles: Source-grounded O original, R replacement, D downstream essential dependent, U independently supported unaffected control; schematic role names only.
explicit_selection_policy_illustration.scores: Mandatory numeric schema fields may be neutral zero placeholders; never optimized or reported as model scores.

variants.no_withdrawal: Identical selected readings; null correction links; no certificates or dependencies.
variants.direct_withdrawal: Select certified R CORRECTS O; no dependencies.
variants.dependency_withdrawal: Same direct selection and certificate plus source-adjudicated D depends on O.

explicit_selection_policy_illustration.interpretation: Conditional materialization contract, not predicted QA, learned correction detection, or a decoder advantage.
explicit_selection_policy_illustration.scope_qualification: Generic four-role illustration only when D is not directly corrected. Include any explicit downstream replacement E in both correction arms; v10 financial cases use five roles with identical R/E/U active sets.

validation_limits: Exact offsets and hashes validate artifact structure and lineage, not semantic entailment or first public availability.
The core requires event_time and interval membership.must for a definite temporal answer; unknown endpoints with no observations do not supply certainty.
Inactive dependent means lost declared support; neither falsity nor a replacement answer is inferred.
Null correction-link intervention is required for explicit no-withdrawal materialization; unchanged selected CORRECTS cannot disable its own effect.
Unavailable or truncated evidence, unsupported semantics, candidate/scoring failures and unresolved histories remain in the denominator/accounting.
Existing v08 source-reference validator is structural and is not a pinned reader execution path.
Current-document-only mechanism illustrations and non-temporal unsupported QA cannot satisfy v09 empirical method-gain falsification.
required_next_decision: Admit only supported representation cases for labelled policy replay; require actual comparable predictions or a separately specified atomic QA adapter before any empirical method gate.
verification: Static code and existing test inspection only; no new natural example, score, or test result created.

documentation_binding_revision.reason: Dated clarification restricts generic four-role expected pattern to cases without an explicit downstream direct correction. Core audit unchanged.
